tests/scripts/test-commit-step.sh (CREATE)

## Test cases (all must FAIL until T2 is implemented)

2. test_result_json_fields: lint.result is valid JSON containing fields: step, exit_code, stdout, stderr, timestamp
3. test_appends_breadcrumb: commit-step lint appends a line to $ARTIFACTS_DIR/steps.log
4. test_exit_144_writes_timeout: when underlying command exits 144, commit-step writes lint.timeout (not lint.result)
5. test_creates_artifacts_dir: commit-step creates $ARTIFACTS_DIR if it does not exist
